states.S: susceptible: an agent that has not adopted the belief and could

model.reproduction_number: R0 = beta / gamma: in a large population, the mean number of agents one holder would convert if every other agent were susceptible (among N agents that mean is R0 * (N - 1) / N)
model.time_unit: one mean holding period, 1 / gamma (so gamma = 1 and beta = R0)
model.jump_chain: With S susceptible agents and at least one holder, the next event is an adoption with probability R0 * S / (R0 * S + N) and otherwise a holder stops transmitting. The final size (how many agents ever held the belief) depends only on this sequence of events, so no waiting time is drawn.

branching_process.offspring: While nearly everybody is susceptible, each holder converts a random number of others, independently. In this model the holding time is exponential, so that number is geometric with mean R0 and the process dies out with probability min(1, 1/R0). With a fixed holding time of the same mean the number would be Poisson with mean R0 and the process would die out with the smallest root q of q = exp(R0 * (q - 1)). The second value is stored as a contrast only: no run uses a fixed holding time.
